Title: No more timeouts on the first of the month - Orvelline blog

# No more timeouts on the first of the month

Every month, a third of all pass bookings arrive in the first two days, and every
September the start of term doubles that. Until this year our fare engine confirmed every
fare while your request waited, and at the peak some of those requests timed out after
thirty seconds, leaving travel desks unsure whether a pass had been booked.

From version 2.6 the API answers at once even at the peak. When a fare needs longer, we
hold the seats for you and tell you when to come back for the booking; integrators who
follow the troubleshooting guide for the new answer finish the booking a second or two
later, with no risk of booking twice.

Over the September peak, the slowest one per cent of bookings completed in 2.4 seconds,
down from 31.
